subject: Mock Tests
chapter: Claude CCAF Practice Mock 2 (Official Google Practice Exam - 60Q)
description: Full-length 60-question simulated certification examination covering Prompt Caching prefixes, ReAct loops, MCP stdio protocols, and Enterprise Security guardrails.

questions.question: [RAW-GQ-001] Scenario testing Google / Anthropic Claude 3.5 Sonnet systems and orchestration.
options: Option A with unconstrained loops or random retries
Option B with orchestrator state tracking, prompt caching prefix rules, and JSON Schema enforcement
Option C using open-source fallback models
Option D with raw text parsing without schema validation
questions.answer: Option B with orchestrator state tracking, prompt caching prefix rules, and JSON Schema enforcement
questions.explanation: Standard Anthropic system guidelines dictate exact prefix matches for prompt caching (1024 token minimum), orchestrator-managed state machines, and stdio transport for local MCP servers.
questions.examTrick: Prefix identity is mandatory for Prompt Caching. 429 errors demand exponential backoff with jitter.
